regime.summary: Policy rate held at 10.5% but the bill curve sits 1.00pp above it, so hikes are priced; CPI is rising and Brent is up 81% in three months with the rupee flat. KSE100 is down 14.6% in a month and foreign corporates are heavy sellers. This looks like an oil and tightening shock, not a bottom. Hold a small oil-linked core, keep most capital in cash, and wait for a known trigger.

Regime: 6M T-bill minus policy rate +1.00pp (market pricing hikes); CPI rising over 3 months (+0.8pp)
Lesson: hold bills, and set a trigger to return.
Lesson: hold the core; keep cash ready for a weekend gap.

watch.subject: Next MPC: hold or hike
watch.trigger: Hold with the 6M bill still above 10.5% keeps stance neutral; a hike or bill cutoff falling back to the policy rate changes the regime read. Date not in the pack.

watch.trigger: Enter in stages only on a known trigger: Brent stops rising and the index closes up after a low. Base rate is not a tradable edge without that trigger.
